comment: Ambient life (Phase B, B10): presentation only - nothing here is a creature of the simulation, is hit, heard by the game, saved or
read. Each kind is one MultiMesh drawn entirely by its shader (paths and wingbeats computed on the GPU from each instance's seed).
'mesh' is its shape (bird, butterfly, point) and 'motion' how it moves (circle: a flock circling; wander: a small loop; glow: a
blinking light; by default from the mesh). Birds are placed from a fixed seed over the hollow in 'flocks'. Small life lives
'around_camera': its animals wrap round the camera within that many metres, stood on the ground where they come to be and kept to
their 'grounds' (world material IDs) - dense near the player at no cost. 'altitude' metres over the ground, 'radius' of the path,
'speed' in turns a second, 'size' a scale on the mesh. day_only / night_only by the run's hour; 'weather' lists the states it appears
'perched' (PerchedRavens): the rigged raven standing at each of its spots ([x, z, height above the ground]) by day, its clips by state (takeoff,
flap, soar, idle); it takes off when the camera comes within flee_m and is back return_s after the camera has gone well away.

birds.note: Crows circling high over the hollow, the road and the moor - six flocks of five (world life 2026-10-15; was three of five over the hollow).

butterflies.note: Sparse 4.2-6.7 cm butterflies wandering low over the meadow and the Charwood's glades; four rounded wings, bodies and restrained markings.

fireflies.note: Fireflies drifting and blinking in the Charwood at night.

larks.note: Small birds wheeling low over the open ground by day, quicker and tighter than the crows (world life 2026-10-15).

bats.note: Bats hunting low and fast at night, where the crows were by day (world life 2026-10-15).

perched.note: WildMesh 100 MODELS premium Raven (staged 2026-10-14; clip idle = Stand_01, hit = Trans_Stand_to_Flying, walk = Loco_Flying_Flapping, run = Loco_Flying_Glide, all in place). Each spot is [x, z, height above the ground]: perched on the waystation fence, the ruined cart, the overturned wain, the lantern shrine's stone, a Sunk Barrow beam, Cairnwold's south wall and the hen pen - the moor grass hides a raven on the ground.
